title: Host identity
description: GET /v2/host (identity fields: capability host-identity): which daemon this is, in one call for a host switcher.

cutexBuild.description: Build identity of the cutex binary (same as /v2/capabilities cutexBuild). release / commit / builtAt are null on builds that did not set CUTEX_RELEASE / CUTEX_COMMIT / CUTEX_BUILD_TIME (dev builds).

version.description: Cargo package version (not a release id).

channel.description: Release channel the binary was built for: release (public / colleague builds, CUTEX_CHANNEL=release or the older stable) or main (default, owner / dev builds). Older daemons sent dev / stable.

hostId.description: Machine name; shared by every cutex home on the machine.

instanceId.description: Random id created once per cutex home (<cutex home>/instance-id, e.g. ci-<32 hex>) and never changed; same as /v2/capabilities instanceId. A different value at the same address means the daemon (home) was replaced.

osVersion.description: Short human OS version, best effort, e.g. "Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200" or "Ubuntu 24.04.1 LTS" (os-release PRETTY_NAME); null when unknown.

executable.description: Path of the running cutex executable.

runtimes.description: Owner only (null for other principals or when the stores cannot be read): runtimes selected for new agents and how many agents use each.

serviceManager.description: What keeps this daemon running (backend auto-update RFC P0).

kind.description: systemd (Linux user units), cutex-supervisor (`cutex service run`, Windows logon task), runtime-host (owner hosts on Windows) or none (started by hand).

managedInstall.description: The daemon runs from a `cutex service install` layout; only such installs can be upgraded with `cutex upgrade` / /v2/upgrade.

version.description: Native version (0.162.1-r53); null for Claude runtimes and unregistered native builds.

inUse.description: Selected entry plus every entry with agents, newest first.
